It is imperative to note that certain types of tumors are best seen in different modalities, like edema, which is best seen in T2-weighted sequences and FLAIR images. Necrosis is best visible in the T1 post-contrast sequence, and an enhancing tumor is best seen in the T1c postcontrast sequence (13).
